## Open

### F-474 — The kustomize e2e asserted a pass's work before any pass read the switch

> _2026-10-10 · test/blong-int-kustomize · open_

Three CI runs read `0 obsolete, 0 deleted` from the operator and treated it as a prune that never
happens. Those passes were reconciling the declaration from _before_ the switch, because the runbook
applies the switched-off tree and asserts the operator's removal in the same run: the operator reads
the CR at the start of a pass, which is up to a resync interval later. The artifact settled it -
`status.deployments` still named mysql and the CR carried `services: {mysql: false}` two seconds
after that pass's own timestamp. The lesson is that a check of a reconciler's outcome has to wait
for the reconciler's precondition first, and to say which of the two it was waiting for; otherwise a
whole investigation chases a defect that no run has exercised.
